color.note: Cool neutrals + one accent (norte, cobalt) + one highlighter (lime). Nothing warm, nothing warm off-white, no gradients.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. A cold white, never warm off-white. Titles and running text sit here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, selectable list rows, the back of the flashcard, floating menu.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: sidebar, progress track, empty streak cells, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: List dividers and separators. Decorative: never the only cue of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox, and secondary button borders (3:1 over ground, surface, and sunken).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and primary text, over ground, surface, and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary running text and descriptions, over ground, surface, and sunken.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, timestamps, counters, over ground, surface, and sunken.

tokens.name: norte
tokens.usage: The single accent: primary action, current entry, link, progress. As text, over ground, surface, sunken, and norte-soft.

tokens.name: norte-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed of a norte surface.

tokens.name: norte-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind norte text: selected entry, active tag.

tokens.name: on-norte
tokens.usage: Text and icons over a norte fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text: a norte alias.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Highlighter: background of highlights and the only secondary color touch. Only as a background, never as text.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text over lime (the highlighted passage) in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, correct, on time: always with a word or an icon. As text, over ground, surface, and sunken.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error, wrong, late: always with a word or an icon. As text, over ground, surface, and sunken.

tokens.name: streak-0
tokens.usage: A day with no study in the streak grid.

tokens.name: streak-1
tokens.usage: Streak grid: little study.

tokens.name: streak-2
tokens.usage: Streak grid: moderate study.

tokens.name: streak-3
tokens.usage: Streak grid: a good day.

tokens.name: streak-4
tokens.usage: Streak grid: a full day. Same value as norte in the light theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px, 2px away from the control.

groups.name: Titles
groups.note: Schibsted Grotesk. The title is the focal moment of the page: large, heavy, with plenty of air around it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title (trail, course, plan). One per page, with space-11 above and space-9 below.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Secondary page title (lesson, note) and focus screens.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Sections inside the page. space-9 above, space-4 below.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: List row, flashcard, and group titles.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The same Schibsted, in small sizes, for everything that is a control.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Tags, chips, column headers. No forced all-caps.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Geist. Running text at ~65ch, with generous line spacing.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I want to understand how a program becomes machine instructions.
styles.usage: The objective line under the title and reading texts (notes, lessons).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A lexer turns a sequence of characters into tokens.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Supporting text in lists and cards.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Commit Mono, only for numbers, metrics, timestamps, and code. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The number of a Stat (streak, hours, cards).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks in notes.

spacing.note: 4px base, but the rhythm is deliberately uneven: small inside components, large between title and content.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon ↔ label, between tag and tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner padding of tags; gap between streak cells (3px is its exception).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of controls and rows; section title → content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of panels and of the flashcard; between entries of a trail.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections; page title → first section.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Side page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Air above the page title.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: End of the page; separation between large blocks on focus screens.

radius.note: Subtle corners. No wide cards with heavy rounding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Streak cells, highlighter, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, flashcard, floating menu. The maximum for rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only the track and the progress bar, plus the status dot.

shadow.note: Depth comes from surfaces and borders, not from shadow. One short shadow only for what floats.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating menu, popovers, command palette. Never on resting cards.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px of the background color, then a solid 2px of focus.
